scripts.test:unit: vitest run core adapters server scripts --exclude **/*.integration.test.ts --exclude **/*.contract.test.ts
scripts.arch:check: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs core adapters features shared app
scripts.test:coverage: INTEGRATION_DB_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$INTEGRATION_DB_DIR"' EXIT && INTEGRATION_DB_PATH="$INTEGRATION_DB_DIR/coverage.db" && touch "$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH" && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH pnpm prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH TEST_DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH RUN_DB_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run --coverage --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:e2e: E2E_DB_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$E2E_DB_DIR"' EXIT && E2E_DB_PATH="$E2E_DB_DIR/e2e.db" && touch "$E2E_DB_PATH" && DATABASE_URL=file:$E2E_DB_PATH pnpm prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=file:$E2E_DB_PATH pnpm playwright test
scripts.test:integration: INTEGRATION_DB_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$INTEGRATION_DB_DIR"' EXIT && INTEGRATION_DB_PATH="$INTEGRATION_DB_DIR/integration.db" && touch "$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH" && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH pnpm prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH TEST_DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH RUN_DB_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run server/infrastructure/persistence/repositories.integration.test.ts && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH TEST_DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH RUN_DB_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run server/infrastructure/persistence/prisma-catalog-write-adapter.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:catalog: INTEGRATION_DB_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$INTEGRATION_DB_DIR"' EXIT && INTEGRATION_DB_PATH="$INTEGRATION_DB_DIR/catalog.db" && touch "$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH" && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH pnpm prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH TEST_DATABASE_URL=file:$INTEGRATION_DB_PATH RUN_DB_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run server/infrastructure/persistence/prisma-catalog-write-adapter.integration.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm arch:check && pnpm test && pnpm build:test
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
